title: Changelog Writer From Git
tagline: Turn conventional commit records into a stable release note.
summary: Read a real Git revision range, preserve migration footers and revert references, then export reproducible Markdown with a source receipt.

stages.title: Read an immutable Git export
stages.summary: Consume one hash and subject per tab-separated line, rejecting duplicate hashes, malformed hexadecimal IDs and empty subjects.

stages.title: Classify conventional subjects
stages.summary: Parse type, optional scope and optional breaking marker from the first colon-space boundary.

stages.title: Group commits with stable ordering
stages.summary: Map breaking changes to their own section before feature and fix groups.

stages.title: Render bounded release notes
stages.summary: Validate a release label, enforce a maximum commit count and emit sections in a fixed order.
